protocol: Original 75 retained in sequence, then request-ID SHA256 order; five fixed paths (1..5). Both endpoints identical across paths. Same feature encoder and legacy service. All-query exact-set accuracy primary; baseline-75 unseen IDs fixed, dynamic unseen separate. Main methods B-only threshold .5, old-score calibrated forward threshold .5, full inverse alpha=1. Auxiliary B-only threshold chosen on registry by leave-one-group-out exact match from .1 to .9 (ties closest to .5, then higher). Compare all three pairwise on identical requests. Endpoint intervals resample dialogues/dbs, 2000, seed 251121. No selection on the test. Eight Spider databases separately evaluated using development fits.
